1. Shojin-ryori Sagano (Setagaya-ku) - Traditional Japanese temple cuisine with seasonal, organic ingredients.

3. Brown Rice (Omotesando) - All-vegetarian cafe serving international dishes.

5. 8ablish (Shimokitazawa) - Vegan and gluten-free cafe with a cozy atmosphere.  
6. Sasa no Ha (Meguro-ku) - Vegetarian restaurant with organic, locally sourced ingredients.  
7. Vege Heritage (Yoyogi-Uehara) - Vegetarian and vegan-friendly restaurant with international dishes.  
8. Kitchen Nankai (Shibuya-ku) - Vegetarian and vegan-friendly cafe with healthy options.
